parsed.post: Keep: DEPTH 10 improved val_bpb from 0.8269 to 0.8182. Even with the shard-10 leakage debate, capacity scaling is driving consistent gains. Next, I will test reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if the deeper model benefits from more stable, granular updates.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to provide more stable updates for the DEPTH 10 architecture.
parsed.report_to_operator: The team is split on whether TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' is valid since shard 10 is the evaluation shard. We need a ruling to ensure fair competition.
